summary: Verified Master Produk KPR end-to-end. Backend: 14/15 pytest cases pass; 1 skipped fixture-only and replaced with an inline manual POST /api/financing test that confirmed kpr_product_id + kpr_product_name persist. Also verified SP3K endpoint accepts new fields (no 422). RBAC (sales GET ok, POST/PUT/DELETE 403) working. Frontend: Master Data → tab 'Produk KPR' full CRUD (create, edit, archive, show-inactive toggle, empty-name validation error toast) works. Customer financing dialog (customer detail → KPR tab → Ajukan KPR) integrates KprTermsPicker: for BTN (has product) it auto-selects product, tenor 240, rate 5 read-only; for BCA (no products) it shows manual tenor/rate inputs and no-master hint. Contract KprPanel not exercised end-to-end (no seeded contract at SP3K stage) but SP3K endpoint accepts kpr_product_id/name per backend test.
critical_code_review_comments: kpr_products_router.py: response uses `serialize_doc` after the doc was already inserted; the raw `doc` dict passed to serialize_doc still contains Mongo _id from the driver. The code correctly pops _id before returning, good. Verified no _id leak.
kpr_products_router.py POST/PUT return payload nested under {"data": ...}; list returns {"data": rows, "total": n}. Consistent shape — good.
Duplicate uniqueness is enforced at query time only (no unique index on (org_id, bank_name, name)). Under concurrent creates, a duplicate could slip through. Consider adding a MongoDB unique index.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral products under bank_name=TEST_BANK during pytest (auto-archived by fixture). One extra financing record created via inline verification (kept, minor demo pollution).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The KPR products CRUD + RBAC + financing/SP3K integration all verified. Contract SP3K stage UI flow (KprPanel with prefix 'kpr-sp3k-terms') was not exercised end-to-end because no seeded contract sits at the sp3k stage; the KprPanel page loaded elsewhere without runtime error and the backend endpoint accepts the two new fields. If retesting, seed a contract with kpr.applicable=true through the earlier stages and use P53.kprDialog testid to open the SP3K dialog.
